about.name: UNITE general FASTA release for Fungi (v10.0, 2025-02-19)
about.quote: This release consists of a single FASTA file: the RepS/RefS of all SHs, adopting the dynamic use of gap values whenever available.
about.label: UNITE Community

about.name: nucleotide-transformer-v2-50m-multi-species
about.quote: Part of this collection is the nucleotide-transformer-v2-50m-multi-species, a 50M parameters transformer pre-trained on a collection of 850 genomes from a wide range of species, including model and non-model organisms.
about.label: InstaDeep model card (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0)

here: Here: 247 hand-picked well-known species, one UNITE ITS reference sequence each, as 4-letter DNA word frequencies (A) and as the Nucleotide Transformer v2 (50M) last-layer states averaged over the sequence (B).
